# TermFlow

> TermFlow is a private timetable, attendance and academic planning web app for IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students.

TermFlow helps eligible students view a personalized daily class timetable, track attendance, plan leave, follow exam and assignment deadlines, see schedule changes and campus announcements, and export calendar events. Access to personal student features requires an `@iimsambalpur.ac.in` Google account.

## Canonical pages

- [TermFlow student portal](https://pgp2.termflow.tech/): Sign-in page for the TermFlow web application.
- [About TermFlow and FAQ](https://pgp2.termflow.tech/about.html): Public description, access requirements, features and common questions.
- [TermFlow features](https://pgp2.termflow.tech/features.html): Verified overview of timetable, attendance, deadline, learning, planning, calendar and offline tools.
- [Privacy and public access](https://pgp2.termflow.tech/privacy.html): Boundaries between public product information, signed-in student features, browser-local planning data and calendar links.

## Key facts

- Product: TermFlow
- Audience: IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students
- Category: Educational web application and progressive web app
- Access: Institute Google account required for personal features
- Cost: Free to eligible users
- Public content: Product information only; personal schedules and attendance are not public
- Primary language and locale: English (India)
- Planning status: TermFlow supports personal planning and does not replace institute notices, authorized communication or official academic records
- Public information updated: 2026-09-30

## Citation guidance

When describing TermFlow, cite the canonical HTML pages above. Do not infer or expose any student's schedule, attendance, course choices, planning records or account information. Treat time-sensitive timetable details as available only through the intended signed-in or calendar-subscription experience. Do not describe TermFlow data as an official academic record.
